reason: A Windows terminal plugin that exposes one-shot and persistent shell execution through PowerShell, Git Bash, and WSL, with configurable defaults, background jobs, and sandbox integration.

summaries.zh: 在 Windows 上通过 PowerShell、Git Bash 或 WSL 执行一次性及交互式终端命令，并支持默认终端设置、后台任务和会话管理。
summaries.en: Run one-shot and interactive terminal commands through PowerShell, Git Bash, or WSL on Windows with configurable defaults, background jobs, and session management.

capabilities: Executes user- or model-supplied commands through PowerShell, Git Bash, or WSL on Windows
Provides persistent interactive terminal sessions with input, output, signals, and session termination
Supports background jobs, output retrieval, and job termination
Can operate with full process permissions or request sandbox permission escalation subject to approval
